author: Yffe
content: Implement forge build: reuse check_file's pipeline front (parse/validate/check_effects), then thermite_lower::lower_l1 -> write a self-contained crate into a per-run check::ScratchDir (reuse #53 Drop guard) -> invoke real rustc (exit-checked, --crate-name gotcha, SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=0 + --remap-path-prefix for byte-reproducibility). Default rlib; --entry appends a deterministic generated main synthesizing fixed sample inputs per param type. BuildManifest (separate struct composing effects_of, not the frozen Certificate schema) records artifact path/crate-type, honest L1 assurance, per-fn fx rows (the #57 hook), reproducibility. New ForgeError::{RustcAbsent,RustcSpawn,RustcOutput}. Verified by forge/tests/build_conformance.rs (6 tests, AC-1..AC-7) against conformance/build/cases.json.
